ItemID: unavailable; Title: Echo Dot (3rd Gen, 2018 release) - Smart speaker with Alexa - Charcoal; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Alexa fits my Fire TV setup, but I would choose a display over this speaker today.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Echo Dot (4th Gen) | Smart speaker with clock and Alexa | Twilight Blue; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The clock and voice controls are useful, but I do not currently need a bedside speaker.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Fire TV Stick streaming device with Alexa built in, includes Alexa Voice Remote, HD, latest release; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I already have a Fire TV Stick 4K and a Fire TV television, so this HD stick adds little.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Echo Show 5 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- Smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Charcoal; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try this for convenient Alexa controls and a small screen alongside my home electronics.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Fire TV Stick (3rd Gen) with Alexa Voice Remote (includes TV controls) + Star Wars The Mandalorian remote cover (Grogu Green); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Another streaming stick feels redundant, and the themed cover does not meet a need I have.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Echo (4th Gen) | Glacier White with Sengled Bluetooth Color bulb | Alexa smart home starter kit; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Voice-controlled lighting interests me, but I would try the Echo Show before adding another Alexa device.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: TOZO T10 Bluetooth 5.3 Wireless Earbuds with Wireless Charging Case IPX8 Waterproof Stereo Headphones in Ear Built in Mic Headset Premium Sound with Deep Bass for Sport White (2022 Upgraded); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My current interests are home viewing and security equipment; I am not looking for earbuds.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Amazon Fire HD 8 tablet, 8" HD display, 64 GB, (2020 release), designed for portable entertainment, Black; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Portable viewing appeals to me, but I would choose the larger Full HD tablet on this page.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Echo Dot (4th Gen) | Smart speaker with Alexa | Twilight Blue; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: It fits my interest in connected home devices, but the Echo Show offers a more useful addition today.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Fire HD 10 Tablet (10.1" 1080p full HD display, 64 GB) – Black (2019 Release); ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try the larger Full HD screen for watching videos away from my television.
